subject: Greenshore POC: success criteria, kickoff window, and implementation cadence
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Conway <alyssa@greenshore.io>
Cc: Kevin Miller <kevin.miller@greenshore.io>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenshore POC: success criteria, kickoff window, and implementation cadence

Hi Alyssa — great call earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment before a formal SOW: 

Recap (from our discovery)
- Goal: reduce manual tagging and triage time for insights pipelines by 60% during peak workloads.
- Available data: 3 months of labeled events, live API access to event stream (staging).
- Constraints: no data leaves Greenshore environment; prefer VPC/private deployment if PII paths needed.

Proposed POC success criteria (please confirm / adjust)
1) Precision on triage classifier >= 88% on the evaluation set you shared
2) End-to-end inference latency <= 250ms median for 512-token requests in staging
3) Cost target: equivalent or better than current baseline (we'll run cost delta after week 2)

Timeline options (pick one)
A) 3-week sprint: Kickoff week of Apr 12, weekly checkins Wed 10am PT, final readout on week 3
B) 5-week phased: Kickoff Apr 12, two-week integration, two-week validation, final readout week 5

Immediate asks
- Confirm the success criteria above or propose edits by EOD Monday (Apr 5).
- Confirm preferred kickoff week (A or B) and who will be the technical POC on your side.

I've attached a short meeting notes doc and a draft runbook for the POC. Once you confirm, I'll loop in Marissa (Customer Success) and Karthik (Sales Eng) to lock owners and the weekly agenda.

Best,
Mateo
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: 20270402-greenshore-mom.docx]

From: Alyssa Conway <alyssa@greenshore.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Miller <kevin.miller@greenshore.io>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenshore POC: success criteria, kickoff window, and implementation cadence

Hi Mateo — thanks for the clear recap. This matches what we discussed; a few quick tweaks from our side: 

Success criteria notes
- Precision target: can we split metrics by intent bucket? For our use case, we care about "fraud" and "ops" buckets — we want >=85% for fraud and >=90% for ops.
- Latency: 250ms median is fine but can we also set a P95 target <= 420ms?
- Cost: rather than absolute cost target, let's aim for a 25% improvement in cost-per-processed-event over current infra.

Timeline: we prefer the 5-week phased approach (option B) due to scheduling on our side. Kickoff: Apr 19 would be safer — our Product and Data Engineering teams are in a release freeze the week of Apr 12.

Technical POC: Kevin Miller (cc'd) will be the day-to-day technical lead; Priya Rao (security) may loop in for the security questionnaire. I'm attaching the security questions Greenshore requires for pilots.

If that works, can you send a short runbook with ownership and weekly check-in agenda?

Thanks,
Alyssa
Head of Product | Greenshore Analytics
[Attachment: greenshore-security-questions.pdf]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Conway <alyssa@greenshore.io>, Kevin Miller <kevin.miller@greenshore.io>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Greenshore POC: success criteria, kickoff window, and implementation cadence

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Alyssa's confirmation. Key asks: Greenshore prefers a 5-week phased pilot starting the week of Apr 19. They want split metrics by bucket and a P95 latency target. Priya (security) attached a questionnaire. 

Can you please: 
- Propose a week-by-week runbook (owners, milestones, deliverables). I sketched a rough flow below for your context.
- Confirm who from Redwood will lead the weekly sync and the final readout.
- Flag any engineering dependencies (staging keys, data access, VPC setup) and expected lead times.

My rough 5-week flow (fill in details):
Week 0 (prep): agreement sign, access provisioning, baseline set up
Week 1 (integration): ingest sample streams, validation tests, quick model sanity runs
Week 2 (tuning): fine-tune / config tuning, initial metric readouts, cost profiling
Week 3 (validation): larger validation run, P95 and percentile checks, reliability tests
Week 4 (buffer & stabilization): address edge cases, finalize dashboards
Week 5 (final readout): presentation of results, recommended next steps (prod rollout path / Dedicated capacity ask)

Appreciate quick turnaround — Greenshore is eager to start but wants the Apr 19 kickoff.

- Mateo

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Conway <alyssa@greenshore.io>, Kevin Miller <kevin.miller@greenshore.io>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Greenshore POC: success criteria, kickoff window, and implementation cadence

Thanks for the forward — draft runbook and owners below. Karthik, can you confirm infra ETA on the staging keys and VPC peering?

Redwood POC Runbook (5-week phased)
Week 0 (Apr 12–16) — Prep (internal)
- Owners: Marissa (CS lead), Karthik (SE)
- Deliverables: signed pilot agreement, NDAs in place, access request form submitted to Greenshore
- Items: review security questionnaire; Karthik to propose config options for private vs hosted routing

Week 1 (Apr 19–23) — Integration
- Owners: Karthik (technical lead), Greenshore: Kevin (tech POC)
- Deliverables: data ingestion into staging, baseline inference run, integration runbook published (shared drive)
- Weekly sync: Wed Apr 21, 10:00am PT (30m) — topics: ingestion status, blockers, preliminary latency numbers

Week 2 (Apr 26–30) — Tuning
- Owners: Karthik (model tuning), Marissa (ops & cadence)
- Deliverables: tuned model configs, split-metric breakpoint analysis (fraud vs ops), cost profiling report

Week 3 (May 3–7) — Validation
- Owners: Karthik (validation), Greenshore validation team
- Deliverables: P95 & percentile latency reports, precision by intent bucket, reliability run results

Week 4 (May 10–14) — Stabilize
- Owners: Marissa (finalization), Karthik (edge-case fixes)
- Deliverables: dashboards, runbook for production handoff, remediation list closed or scheduled

Week 5 (May 17) — Final readout
- Owners: Marissa (presenter), Mateo (exec sponsor)
- Deliverables: final slide deck, raw metric export, suggested next-step package (Dedicated capacity evaluation + estimated cost)

Attachments: I attached a POC runbook spreadsheet that includes dates, owners, and acceptance gates.

Notes/risks
- VPC peering & staging keys: need confirmation from Greenshore by Apr 15 to meet Apr 19 kickoff.
- Security questionnaire: Priya's answers may trigger an internal compliance task that could add ~3 business days.

I'll take lead on weekly syncs and the final readout with support from Karthik for technical deep dives. 

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-poc-runbook.xlsx]
